title: Image notes
description: A description and the visible text of each image, in the order given.

model.description: The model that wrote the notes.

text.description: Text visible in the image, as written. Empty when there is none.

time.description: Seconds into the video the image came from. see leaves it out. A caller that knows the time adds it.

costUsd.description: Model spend of this call. Zero when every image came from the cache.

cacheHit.description: True when every image came from the cache.
